notes.title: Name Change from 'Witchwood' to 'The Highland Ritual'
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

You may have noticed that our game has changed its title from [b]Witchwood [/b]to [b]The Highland Ritual[/b].
This decision was made after the initial announcement, where we noticed some confusion about the game's theme. While we loved the name Witchwood, it unintentionally gave the impression that the game focused on witches — which isn't the case. To better reflect the tone, setting, and story of the game, we've renamed it to The Highland Ritual.

Nothing else has changed — development is still moving forward, and we can’t wait to share more of what we’ve been working on.

Thank you for your support!
